questions.q:

(1) the default web port of the packaged exe (web/app.mjs)
(2) SQLite busy_timeout in milliseconds set by the Store
(3) the runner's default --max-attempts
(4) maximum number of findings absorbed from one agent output (FINDINGS_MAX)
(5) byte offset of the data directories from the optional-header start for PE32+ in strip-signature.mjs
Give exactly five numbers, in this order, comma-separated, with no units.

Give exactly five numbers, in this order, comma-separated, with no units.
